# Divider

Hairline rules between content, like the lines between sheets on the portfolio.

`border-default` for most rules, `border-strong` under table headers and section ends. The labeled rule opens a group with a sheet code in `mono-label`. Decorative: use `<hr>` or `role="separator"`.
